questions.question: What is the value of (√5 + 2)/ (√5 - 2)?
What is the value of 31 + 32 + ….. 50?
questions.solution:
Let’s consider the series as a geometric progression:

⇒ First term = a = 31; common difference = d = 1

⇒ last term = An = 50

We know, Sum of an AP = n/2 [a + An] (1)

Finding n: 

⇒ An = a + (n - 1)d

⇒ 50 = 31 + nd - 1 = 30 + n

∴ n = 50 - 30 = 20

⇒ Sum = 20/2 [31 + 50] = 10×81 = 810

∴ Sum of the series = 810

questions.question: Which of the following is greatest number?
Two pipes P and Q can fill the tank alone in 60 and 90 hours respectively. If they are opened together, then in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.solution:
Part of tank filled by P in 1 hour = 1/60

Part of tank filled by Q in 1 hour = 1/90

⇒ Part of tank filled by both in 1 hour = 1/60 + 1/90 = (3 + 2)/180 = 5/180

∴ Time taken by both to fill the tank = 180/5 = 36 hours

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 20 hours and pipe B can fill the same tank in 24 hours. Pipe C can empty the same tank in 12 hours. If all the pipes are opened together, then what portion of the tank will be filled after 12 hours?
questions.solution:
Part filled by A in 1 hour = 1/20

Part filled by B in 1 hour = 1/24

Part emptied by C in 1 hour = 1/12

∴ part filled when all are opened in 1 hour = 1/20 + 1/24 - 1/12 = (6 + 5 - 10)/120 = 1/120

∴ Portion of tank filled in 12 hours = 12 × (1/120) = 1/10

questions.question: A shop - keeper offers 30% discount on bags which have been marked 60% above the cost price. Rahul bought the bag for Rs. 672. What was the cost price (in Rs) of the bag?
A merchant purchases a watch for Rs 540 and fixes its marked price in such a way that after allowing a discount of 10%, he earns a profit of 35%. What is the marked price (in Rs) of the watch?
questions.solution:
Let the MP = x

⇒ CP = 540 (Given)

SP = x - 0.1x = 0.9x

Profit = 35%

⇒ (SP - CP)/CP = 0.35

⇒ (0.9x - 540)/540 = 0.35

⇒ 0.9x - 540 = 189

⇒ 0.9x = 729

⇒ x = 729/0.9 = 810

∴ MP = Rs. 810

 

Alternative Method:

Relationship between CP and MP

CP : MP = (100 - D%) : (100 + P%)

CP : MP = (100 - 10) : (100 + 35) = 2 : 3

2 unit = 540

∴ 3 units = 810

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 7 : 12. If their difference is 60, then what is the smallest number?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be 7x and 12x

12x - 7x = 60

⇒ 5x = 60

⇒ x = 60/5 = 12

∴ Smallest number = 7x = 7 × 12 = 84

questions.question: Rs. 2160 is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 respectively. What is the difference (in Rs.) between the shares of A and B?
questions.solution:
Let the shares of A, B and C be 2x, 3x and 5x

⇒ 2x + 3x + 5x = 2160

⇒ 10x = 2160 ⇒ x = 2160/10 = 216

⇒ A’s share = 216 × 2 = 432; B’s share = 3 × 216 = 648

∴ Difference of A’s and B’s shares = 648 - 432 = 216

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is 9.5. If a number 5 is removed, then what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
Given: Average of 10 numbers = 9.5

⇒ (Sum of 10numbers)/10 = 9.5

⇒ Sum of 10 numbers = 95

New sum = Sum of 10 numbers - 5 = 95 - 5 = 90

∴ New average = 90/9 = 10

questions.question: An article is sold at a profit of 30%. If the selling price is doubled, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the CP = x

⇒ SP = x + 0.3x = 1.3x

New SP = 2 × 1.3x = 2.6x

⇒ Profit = (2.6x - x)/x×100 = 160%

∴ Profit % = 160

questions.question: A man sold 400 chairs and had a gain equal to selling price of 50 chairs. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the SP of 1 chair = x

⇒ SP of 400 chairs = 400x

Given, Profit = 50x

⇒ CP = 400x - 50x = 350x

∴ Profit % = [(400x - 350x)/350x] ×100 = 14.28%

questions.question: 1000 is first increased by 10% and then it is decreased by 30%. What is the final value?
questions.solution:
Initial value = 1000

⇒ After increase of 10% = 1000 + 0.1 × 1000 = 1100

After decrease of 30%:

⇒ 1100 - 0.3 × 1100 = 1100 - 330 = 770

∴ Final value = 770

questions.question: Out of the total bags, 30% of bags are green coloured. 30% of remaining bags are red coloured. 40% of remaining bags are yellow coloured. The remaining 1176 bags are blue coloured. How many total bags are there?
questions.solution:
Let the total number of bags = x

Green coloured bags = 0.3x

⇒ Remaining bags = x - 0.3x = 0.7x

⇒ Red coloured bags = 0.3 × 0.7x = 0.21x

Remaining bags = 0.7x - 0.21x = 0.49x

Yellow coloured bags = 0.4 × 0.49x = 0.196x

⇒ Remaining bags = 0.49x - 0.196x = 0.294x

Given: 0.294x = 1176

⇒ x = 1176/0.294 = 4000

∴ Total no. of bags = 4000

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 8 km/hr. It covers a distance of 40 km upstream in 8 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the stream?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of stream = a km/hr

⇒ Speed upstream = 8 - a km/hr

Distance = 40 km; Time = 8 hours

⇒ Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ 8 - a = 40/8 = 5

⇒ a = 8 - 5 = 3 km/hr

∴ Speed of stream = 3 km/hr

questions.question: A 400 metres long train crosses a bridge 600 metres long in 50 seconds. What is speed (in km/hr) of the train?
questions.solution:
Total distance covered = 400 + 600 = 1000 m

⇒ Speed = 1000/50 = 20 m/s

∴ Speed of train = 20 × (18/5) = 72 km/hr (∵ Multiplied by 18/5 to convert to km/hr)

questions.question: A sum becomes 4 times in 2 years at compound interest. In how many years the same sum will become 16 times?
What is the average number of students playing Tennis and Cricket?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Tennis = 1080 × (108/360) = 324

No. of students playing Cricket = 1080 × (72/360) = 216

∴ Average = (324 + 216)/2 = 540/2 = 270

questions.question: What is the difference between the number of students who play Tennis and those who play Polo?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Tennis = 1080 × (108/360) = 324

No. of students playing Polo = 1080 × (36/360) = 108

∴ Difference = 324 - 108 = 216

questions.question: In which of the following group of sports, the sum of the number of students who play in the first 2 groups is equal to that of the third group?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Tennis = 1080× (108/360) = 324

No. of students playing Polo = 1080× (36/360) = 108

No. of students playing Cricket = 1080× (72/360) = 216

No. of students playing Hockey = 1080× (90/360) = 270

No. of students playing Golf = 1080× (54/360) = 162

Checking each option one by one:

1: Cricket + Polo = 216 + 108 = 324 is not equal to hockey

2: Hockey + Tennis = 270 + 324 = 594 is not equal to Golf

3: Cricket + Polo = 216 + 108 = 324 = Tennis

4: Hockey + Cricket = 270 + 216 = 486 is not equal to Tennis

∴ Option 3 is correct.

questions.question: What is the total number of students who play either Hockey or Cricket?
questions.solution:
No. of students playing Cricket = 1080 × (72/360) = 216

No. of students playing Hockey = 1080 × (90/360) = 270

∴ Total no. of students who play either Hockey or Cricket = 270 + 216 = 486
